messages:
Alex P: Quick sync — finishing INC-834 postmortem actions. Please confirm owners + final due dates so I can close. I'll list items below.

Maria G: Can you paste the action table or link the doc?

Alex P: Doc: https://redwoodinc.atlassian.net/browse/INC-834?actionTable — tl;dr list from the RCA:
- Samir: add retry logic to cache layer
- Cheng: infra rollback protection + runbook
- Maria: update external comms and SOC audit note
- eng-infra: finish migration of feature flag

Samir K: I started the retry patch, PR #1287 opened: https://github.com/redwood-inc/repo/pull/1287. Running tests locally: ```pytest tests/test_retry.py -k cache -q``` target Fri 2024-08-09 EOD. :eyes:

Cheng L: Runbook draft is ready but blocked on feature-flag migration. Need an eng-infra assignee to coordinate cutover and DB freeze window.

Infra Bot: @eng-infra there is a dependency request from INC-834: feature-flag migration. Please respond with ETA or assign an owner.

Maria G: I can take external comms after Samir's change lands and we've validated smoke tests. Tentative slot: Mon 2024-08-12 for publishing the customer note.

Alex P: Cheng — who on eng-infra owns the migration? @Sam? @Priya?

Samir K: Priya mentioned she'd help earlier but I don't have an explicit assignee. @Priya could you confirm timeline here?

Priya R: I'll own the infra migration. Targeting 2024-08-10 morning UTC. Need a DB freeze window 08:00-09:30 UTC for the cutover. I'll post the schedule + checklist in a follow-up. :calendar:

Cheng L: DB freeze noted. I'll update the runbook with the freeze window, verification steps, and explicit rollback commands. New runbook link once updated: https://docs.redwood.com/incidents/INC-834/runbook

Alex P: Ok — final due dates to lock in now:
- Samir K: 2024-08-09 EOD (merge + deploy)
- Priya R / eng-infra: 2024-08-10 09:30 UTC (end of freeze + verification)
- Maria G: 2024-08-12 (external comms published)
I'll plan to close the incident on 2024-08-13 unless anything is blocked. If a task slips, mark it as "blocker" in this thread and tag me.

Samir K: ack :thumbsup: — will update PR with requested tests today.

Priya R: ack, will post migration playbook and PR links once scheduling is finalized.

Cheng L: marking blocked -> will flip to ready after infra migration completes and smoke passes.

Alex P: Thanks all. I'll follow up in 24h and update the incident tracker. If any TODO needs reassigning ping me directly.
